name: fld_irreducible_X_sq_add_X_add_one_zmod_iff
statement: (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] : Irreducible (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial (ZMod p)) ↔ p % 3 = 2
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], Irreducible (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial (ZMod p)) ↔ p % 3 = 2
informal: X^2 + X + 1 is irreducible over F_p iff p ≡ 2 (mod 3) — a monic quadratic is irreducible iff it has no root; for p = 3 it is (X-1)^2; for p ≠ 3 a root is exactly an element of multiplicative order 3, which exists iff 3 | p - 1 (cyclic unit group).
type: ∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)], Irreducible (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.X + 1) ↔ p % 3 = 2
